claims.claim_text: CACI generated 75.4% of total revenues in fiscal 2025 from contracts with agencies of the DoD, and 95.7% from federal government contracts overall (prime or sub).
claims.subject: CACI
claims.source_quote: we generated 75.4% and 74.4% of our total revenues in fiscal 2025 and 2024, respectively, from contracts with agencies of the DoD

claims.claim_text: Top ten revenue-producing contracts accounted for 46.4% of FY2025 revenues, or approximately $4.0 billion, suggesting material concentration in a small set of DoD/IC task-order vehicles.
claims.subject: CACI top-ten contracts
claims.source_quote: For fiscal 2025, the top ten revenue-producing contracts, many of which consist of multiple task orders, accounted for 46.4% of our revenues, or $4.0 billion.

claims.claim_text: CACI markets a 'Spectrum Superiority' line: software-defined, hardware-enabled radio-frequency technology for ISR and electronic warfare, plus specialized photonics and waveforms — positioned as a forward-looking revenue driver in DoD EW programs.
claims.subject: CACI Spectrum Superiority / EW & photonics
claims.source_quote: Spectrum Superiority Design and development of software-defined, hardware enabled technologies ... We design and develop differentiated technology across the radio-frequency (RF) spectrum for intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance (ISR), and electronic warfare (EW) and build specialized photonics, waveforms, and technology to enable secure communications across the battlefield.

claims.claim_text: CACI's C3I market area is a stated growth driver, delivering software-defined SIGINT and electronic-warfare solutions for multi-domain command-and-control — narrative-loadbearing for forward revenue from DoD C3/SIGINT programs.
claims.subject: CACI C3I segment
claims.object_value: software-defined SIGINT + EW for multi-domain C3
claims.source_quote: C3I Ensuring information superiority by delivering multi-domain command, control, communications, and intelligence (C3I) technology and networks. Our software-defined signals intelligence and electronic warfare solutions enable coordinated decision superiority

claims.claim_text: CACI Space market area provides space domain awareness, intelligence fusion, integrated logistics and decision support — positioned as forward exposure to growing Space Force / SDA spend.
claims.subject: CACI Space segment
claims.object_value: SDA + intel fusion + logistics for space domain
claims.source_quote: Space Space domain awareness and decision support capabilities to enable multi-domain operations. We are an industry leader in intelligence fusion, data analytics, and decision support as well as integrated logistics.

claims.claim_text: CACI Cyber market area provides full-spectrum offensive and defensive cyber capabilities through internal R&D — claimed forward revenue from DoD/IC cyber programs.
claims.subject: CACI Cyber segment
claims.source_quote: Cyber Providing full-spectrum cyber capabilities help customers prepare, defend, and sustain their enterprise and mission against cyber threats. Through our research and development (R&D) efforts, we develop and deploy new technologies to conduct offensive and defensive operations

claims.claim_text: CACI provides enterprise IT solutions to approximately 50 federal agencies (Enterprise IT market area) — forward revenue tied to DoD/civilian enterprise-IT modernization spend (e.g., DEOS/EITaaS-style programs).
claims.subject: CACI Enterprise IT
claims.source_quote: We design, implement, protect, and manage secure enterprise IT solutions for approximately 50 federal agencies

claims.claim_text: CACI completed seven acquisitions in the last three fiscal years (three in FY2025, three in FY2024, one in FY2023) including Azure Summit, expanding RF/EMS/photonics — rollup thesis relies on absorbed contract pipelines mapping to live DoD program elements.
claims.subject: CACI acquisition rollup
claims.object_value: 7 acquisitions in 3 years; Azure Summit FY2025
claims.source_quote: During the past three fiscal years, we completed a total of seven acquisitions ... Azure Summit advances DoD mission outcomes with its portfolio of high-performance radio frequency technologies and engineering talent focused on the electromagnetic spectrum.

claims.claim_text: CACI Mission and Engineering Support includes naval architecture, platform integration and modernization, weapons-system sustainment — forward revenue tied to Navy/DoD platform-modernization PEs.
claims.subject: CACI Mission & Engineering Support
claims.object_value: naval architecture + platform mod/sustainment + weapons systems
claims.source_quote: Mission and Engineering Support Platform integration, modernization and sustainment, system engineering, naval architecture, training and simulation services, and logistics engineering

claims.claim_text: CACI owns patents and trade-secret IP but states that its solutions are not substantially dependent on IP protection (control claim, non-J-Book).
claims.subject: CACI intellectual property
claims.source_quote: our solutions and services are not substantially dependent upon obtaining or maintaining intellectual property (IP) protections ... The Company owns patents and claims copyright, trademark, and other proprietary rights

claims.claim_text: CACI employs approximately 25,000 employees as of June 30, 2025 — control claim on workforce scale relative to claimed contract base.
claims.subject: CACI headcount
claims.source_quote: As of June 30, 2025, we employed approximately 25,000 ta lented full and part-time employees
